verdicts.evidence: hybrid-play VIS [2033,3388,4033]: 3388 = 28 x 121, 4033 = 121 x 33.33 ms, the window (90 + 30 rest + 1); Nansouty, Walther, Miloradovich hidden 90/90 play frames and at rest. verdicts.method: independent re-analysis of raw-phone-0900.json / raw-phone-land-0900.json (vis-check.py) + app.js:9017
verdicts.evidence: Reproduced exactly: 7,046/13,635 = 51.7% drawn, fresh 60.1%, 19.1% of hidden with room; lich 0 of 1,365, longest 752 frames = 25,067 ms (09:00-10:30); c_cav 13.1%, constantine 21.4%; phone Landscape 79.6%. But lich's fresh-layout share is 0.15% (2 of 1,365): a fresh layout of the same frames also never draws it, so its absence is crowding under the priority rule at the phone's framing, not the stabiliser. The stabiliser's own share is 60.1 -> 51.7 (8.4 points). The run is a desktop context at 390x844, which gets the phone layout because PHONE_Q is width/height only (app.js:9017).

corrected.origin: mixed: inherited crowding (fresh layout 60.1%, Liechtenstein 0.15% fresh; the phone framing of step 6 item 3 Part B and 2D's priority rule, not traced build by build) plus new-regression (8C's stabiliser, -8.4 points)

verdicts.notes: Severity S3 and priority P3 kept; a secondary path (the phone's default is Landscape).

verdicts.method: independent re-analysis of raw-land-0900.json, raw-land-4x-day.json + app.js:5339, 5477-5482
verdicts.evidence: land-0900: 34,330/38,417 = 89.4% drawn, fresh 99.9%, 4,087 hidden name-frames, 230 episodes over 26 names in 50.3 s (one per name per 5.7 s), mean episode 592 ms, 98.9% with room; worst 1,667 ms (land-0900) and 2,533 ms (Miloradovich, land-4x-day).
